title: Masu Gina Ginshiƙai Masu Tsayi
intro: Kana tsaye a gaban kango na wani tsohon birni mai girma, ginshiƙansa masu tsayi yanzu sun faɗi. Iska tana ta ratsa titunan da babu kowa, tana ɗauke da tunawa da manyan mutane waɗanda suka taɓa mulkin waɗannan ƙasashe. Su waye ne?
clues: Mu mutane ne masu ƙarfi da ƙwarewa sosai, waɗanda aka san su da manyan gine-ginenmu da wayewarmu ta ci gaba.
Mun zauna a ƙasar da ke cike da tuddai masu duwatsu da kuma duwatsu, kuma mun yi imanin cewa babu wanda zai iya rinjaye mu.
Wani manzo ya zo mana daga cikin danginmu, yana kiranmu mu bauta wa Allah shi kaɗai, amma muka ƙi shi muka yi masa ba'a.
Mun yi ta alfahari, 'Wa ya fi mu ƙarfi?' Sai muka ci gaba da girman kanmu da bautar gumaka.
Allah ya aiko mana da iska mai ƙarfi wadda ta yi ta kadawa har tsawon dare bakwai da kwana takwas, ta lalata komai.
Mu ne mutanen Ada, masu gina Iram, kuma ƙaddararmu ta zama gargaɗi ga duk wanda zai zo bayan haka.

trial.label: Menene hukuncin da aka yi musu?
options: Ambaliyar ruwa ta nutsar da mutane

outcome.label: Menene makomarsu ta ƙarshe?
options: An lalata su kuma gawarwakinsu ya zama darasi
Sun tuba kuma aka cece su
An nutsar da su cikin teku
An binne su a ƙarƙashin zaftarewar ƙasa
outcome.answer: An lalata su kuma gawarwakinsu ya zama darasi

arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. (46:25)
